summary.text: Stan Gerdes is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 17 since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as political advisor.

paragraphs.text: Stan Gerdes was born in Texas and lives in Smithville.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas.
His career experience includes working for Rick Perry during Perry's time as governor of Texas and then as U.S. secretary of energy, and he served on the Smithville City Council.
Gerdes is a member of the National Rifle Association.
Gerdes succeeded John Cyrier in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
